description: GPT-4 is OpenAI's foundational large multimodal model that can solve difficult problems with greater accuracy than previous models. It accepts text inputs and produces text outputs (vision capabilities available in separate endpoint).

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse mixture of licensed data, data created by human trainers, and publicly available data.

trainingProcedure: Trained using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) with supervised fine-tuning.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Significantly more capable and reliable than GPT-3.5. Passes simulated bar exam with a score in the top 10% of test takers.

knownLimitations: May generate incorrect or misleading information (hallucinations)
Can exhibit biases present in training data
Smaller context window than newer models
More expensive than GPT-4 Turbo and GPT-4o

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: OpenAI conducted extensive red-teaming and safety evaluations before release.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in content filtering and RLHF training to refuse harmful requests.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Data sent to the API may be used to improve the model unless opted out.
